metric_definitions.exact_match_errors_pct: ok output identical to reference, /1664 erroneous inputs; non-ok counts as not exact
metric_definitions.unchanged_controls_pct: ok output identical to input, /1664 controls; non-ok does NOT count as unchanged
metric_definitions.modified_controls_all_pct: all controls minus successfully unchanged controls, /1664; includes non-ok. Not a pure overcorrection rate.
metric_definitions.latency_all: per-item reported elapsed seconds including non-ok; does not include model load, warmup
metric_definitions.latency_ok: per-item reported elapsed seconds, status ok only
